inputs.style: Fast epic thrash metal, heavy downpicked distorted guitars, forceful male baritone, huge live drums, clear powerful bass, fierce harmonized lead guitars. 176 BPM, F sharp minor. a descending chromatic riff against a steady pulse; a shouted four-word breakdown and accelerating-feeling climax. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Grit under the fingernails, coal in the throat
The whistle screams a warning I cannot ignore
I pull the lever down, the iron groans
Every carriage holds a stolen season, a stolen bone

[Chorus]
Flip the switch! Burn the track!
Time is bleeding through the cracks!

[Verse]
Platform four is empty, but the shadows breathe
They count the seconds missing from my hand
The conductor looks, his clock face cracks
I shatter it against the rails, the silence snaps

[Verse]
The tracks are cold, the schedule is dead
But the years don’t vanish, they’re not fed
They pile up on the platform floor
A mountain of the stolen four
I step into the waiting crowd
And feel the weight of the lost shroud
Every face is young, every hand is grey
They look at me and stare away
I hold the lever, I hold the key
But I can’t give the years back to me
The last train leaves with no one there
I am the one who isn’t fair

[Bridge]
SLOW. DOWN. STOP. NOW.

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Flip the switch! Burn the track!
Time is bleeding through the cracks!

[Chorus]
Flip the switch! Burn the track!
Time is bleeding through the cracks!

[Outro]
Last train halts. Years return. The switchman walks.
